# Files that define the repository's checks.
#
# A pull request that changes any path matched below fails the
# `protected-paths` check. One glob per line, repo-relative, case-sensitive:
# `**` matches any depth, `*` matches within one path segment, anything else
# is an exact name. Blank lines and lines starting with `#` are ignored.
#
# `package.json` is deliberately not listed: the script handles it specially
# and flags it only when its `scripts` or `lint-staged` values change, so a
# dependencies-only change passes.

# CI workflows, this list, and the script that reads it
.github/**

# Git hooks
.husky/**

# Lint, type, and format configuration
eslint.config.mjs
tsconfig.json
.prettierrc
.prettierignore

# Test configuration and shared test setup
jest.config.mjs
playwright.config.ts
src/test/setup.ts
src/test/mocks/**

# Commit message and OpenSpec configuration
commitlint.config.cjs
scripts/commitlint/**
openspec/config.yaml
